title: Medical certificate for university admission
what: A health certificate that a university or college requires. It is issued after exams by several doctors and some tests.
why: When applying to a university or college, and for some programs with extra requirements.
duration: usually 1 to 3 days in all; the certificate is issued after the tests
tell_doctor: Your university's requirements for the certificate

prepare.title: Requirements
prepare.text: Ask the admissions office which form of certificate is needed and whether your program has special requirements.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood and urine are usually given in the morning on an empty stomach. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Vaccinations
prepare.text: Bring your vaccination record or certificate.

bring: Your chest X-ray from the last year, if you have it
steps: You have a chest X-ray if you do not have a recent one
You see a general doctor, eye doctor, ENT, surgeon, neurologist and others on the list
The general doctor completes the certificate
feel: A blood test is a quick needle prick
after: Check that the certificate has all the stamps and signatures
Hand the certificate to the admissions office on time

faq.q: How long is the certificate valid?
faq.a: Usually a few months. It depends on the rules. Ask the university.

faq.q: Is a certificate needed for distance learning?
faq.a: Sometimes it is not. Ask the admissions office.

reminders.text: Medical exam for the university certificate tomorrow. Do not eat in the morning before the tests, and bring your vaccination record.
